author: The Infographics Show
description:
Pancreatic cancer has remained one of the deadliest and most difficult cancers to treat. It hides deep inside the body, suppresses the immune response, and surrounds itself with a dense protective barrier that prevents chemotherapy from reaching the tumor. By the time symptoms appear, the disease has often already spread. But scientists may finally have cracked the code that made it seem “undruggable.”

This video explores the breakthroughs transforming pancreatic cancer treatment, including NALIRIFOX chemotherapy, personalized mRNA cancer vaccines, and new drugs designed to attack KRAS mutations responsible for most pancreatic tumors. Researchers have discovered hidden pockets inside the once-untouchable KRAS protein, allowing treatments such as daraxonrasib to shut down the signals driving cancer growth.

title: Deadliest Cancer Just Met Its Match
